rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese word for the sleeve of a garment.

example.english: The sleeve of your shirt is too long.
example.traditional: 你件恤衫嘅衫袖太長喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 gin6 seot1 saam1 ge3 saam1 zau6 taai3 coeng4 laa3

rows.note: Use this technical term for a tubular sleeve or bushing fitted around a machine part.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tou3 tung4 jiu3 wun6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the protective sleeve or cover of a record, and by extension similar packaged music material.

example.english: This record sleeve has a picture of the singer printed on it.
example.traditional: 呢個唱片封套印咗歌手嘅相。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 coeng3 pin3 fung1 tou3 jan3 zo2 go1 sau2 ge3 soeng2
